# Options {#sec-options-overview}

The **Options** dialog manages the program's global settings.
To open it, click the `r keys("Options")` button in the **Tools** section of the **Home** tab.
(On macOS, you can also select **Preferences** from the application menu.)

## General {#sec-options-general}

The options on this page manage the program's general settings.

### Projects {-}

**Auto-refresh new projects when their data files change**: Check this option to turn on auto refresh for newly created projects.
When auto refresh is on, the project watches its datasets' files and reloads them when they change.
This option only affects new projects; existing projects keep their own setting, which is saved with the project.
To change it for an individual project, click the `r keys("Auto Refresh")` button in the **Pages** section of the **Home** tab.

::: {.notesection data-latex=""}
Auto refresh is only available when all of a project's datasets are imported from local files.
:::

### Log {-}

**Auto-refresh log**: Check this option to automatically update the **Log** tab with new messages while it is open.
This can also be toggled with the `r keys("Auto Refresh")` button on the **Log** tab.

**Verbose logging**: Check this option to include more detailed messages in the log.
This can be useful when troubleshooting.

## Page Setup {#sec-options-page-setup}

The options on this page are the default print settings for projects.

### Paper {-}

**Paper size**: Select the paper size to print to.

### Orientation {-}

**Portrait**: Select this option to print pages in portrait (vertical) orientation.

**Landscape**: Select this option to print pages in landscape (horizontal) orientation.

### Printing {-}

**Duplex**: Select how to print on both sides of the paper:

- **None**: Prints on only one side of each sheet.
- **Flip on long edge**: Prints on both sides of each sheet, flipping pages along the long edge (like a book).
- **Flip on short edge**: Prints on both sides of each sheet, flipping pages along the short edge (like a notepad).

**Collate copies**: Check this option to print multiple copies as complete, ordered sets.

**Print in color**: Check this option to print in color. Uncheck it to print in grayscale.
